# Sum of All Odd Length Subarrays.

@example The single elements add up to 18 and the two windows of 3 to 10 and 12; the whole array has even length and is left out.
[6,1,3,8]
=> 40

@example The single elements give 23, the windows of 3 give 16 + 14 + 16 = 46, and the whole array, of length 5, gives 23 more.
[5,2,9,3,4]
=> 92

@example The three windows [4] hold the same value but sit in different places, so each counts: 12, plus 12 for the whole array.
[4,4,4]
=> 24

# One element.
[1]
=> 1

# Two elements: only the single ones count.
[3,8]
=> 11

# Odd length with different values: the windows of lengths 1, 3, 5 and 7
# give 36 + 73 + 73 + 36. Halving (i + 1) * (n - i) without rounding up
# undercounts the even positions.
[8,3,6,1,9,2,7]
=> 218

# Even length: the windows of lengths 1, 3 and 5 give 28 + 60 + 49; adding
# the even lengths too would be wrong.
[2,9,4,7,1,5]
=> 137

# All equal.
[1,1,1,1,1]
=> 19

# A large value at the end.
[1,1,1,1000]
=> 2008

# Already too large for a 16-bit total.
[1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000]
=> 85000

# 99 elements of 1000.
[1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000]
=> 83350000

# 100 elements of 1000: the largest answer.
[1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000,1000]
=> 85850000

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[3,4,8]
=> 30

@gen 2 small
[3,9,7,5,7,9,1,8]
=> 378

@gen 3 small
[1,7,3,4,10,2]
=> 136

@gen 4 small
[150,521]
=> 671

@gen 11 small
[79,652,614,133,498,270,401,554]
=> 24169

@gen 12 small
[7,1,3,7,1]
=> 71

@gen 14 small
[1,5,2,2,3,6,3,7,3]
=> 306

@gen 20 small
[546,734,629,868,930,565,609]
=> 31830
